calendar: General Roman Calendar as the app computes it: assets/calendar/general/2029.json (romcal 1.3.0)

cycles.note: the cycle turns at the First Sunday of Advent; each day carries its own

sources.felix: Felix Just, S.J., Lectionary index tables for the 1998/2002 USA Lectionary, https://catholic-resources.org/Lectionary/Index-Sundays.htm and Index-Weekdays.htm, retrieved 2026-09-08; copyright Felix Just, S.J.; cited, not copied
sources.cpbjr: cpbjr/catholic-readings-api (MIT), commit 973e9864eb0f of 2026-08-29, readings/2026 and readings/2027: per-day citations derived from USCCB

fields.readings: the day's Mass readings as citations: first, psalm, second (Sundays and solemnities), gospel; on the Easter Vigil also vigil (the Old Testament readings in order) and vigilPsalms. Modern book names, verse numbering as the sources give it
fields.dr: the same with Douay-Rheims book names and Vulgate psalm numbers; verse numbers are not converted
fields.ferial: the weekday's readings when a celebration displaced them
fields.proper: a memorial's own readings when the weekday's are the day's
fields.source: where the readings came from: cpbjr:<date> for 2026 and 2027 (observed); cpbjr:<date> via felix:<key> when a later day maps to the same lectionary day and cycle; felix:<day name>|<cycle> otherwise
fields.observedUS: what USCCB read that day when the app calendar keeps a different celebration (Ascension transferred to Sunday, Thanksgiving Day)
fields.vigil: Easter Vigil only: the seven Old Testament readings in order; vigilPsalms their responses by number (1a/1b are the options after the first reading, 8 follows the epistle)
